title: EPI-PREDIC: browser-based development, validation and sample-size calculation for clinical prediction models
description: Browser tool for clinical prediction model research: minimum sample size for development (Riley et al. criteria, validated against pmsampsize) and external validation (BMJ 2024;384:e074821), logistic, Cox and linear models with restricted cubic splines and ridge/lasso penalisation, bootstrap optimism correction, calibration, recalibration, validation of published equations, decision curve analysis and TRIPOD+AI checklist. All calculations run in the browser.
